stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang under FBI and company investigation over alleged Chinese spy ties
stories.line: Trump says the FBI is probing Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy, and Nvidia is investigating too.

stories.title: FDA orders GLP-1 makers to warn of rare vision-loss side effect
stories.line: The FDA is requiring GLP-1 drug makers to warn of a rare vision-loss side effect, with a heart-risk study adding to concerns about starting and stopping these drugs.

stories.line: Reports say Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by Chinese intelligence, drawing scrutiny over his ties to Trump and a relative's business.
